description: Check order precedence: for each adjacent pair of checks in each operation's check order, a call that fails both and gets the earlier check's error. Pairs pinned by vectors in other files carry their precedence there.

vectors.description: mallory creates for another principal in an asset the factory does not support: the caller check comes first.
A zero budget and an attester in ALLOWLIST mode: the field domains come before the attester check.
An attester in ALLOWLIST mode and a zero address guardian: the attester check comes before the zero address check.
A zero address guardian and the principal as an agent: the zero address check comes before role separation.
The principal is an agent, and an agent is also an approver: the principal check comes first.
An agent and an executor are both approvers: the agent and approver check comes first.
An executor is also an approver and a recovery approver: the executor and approver check comes first.
An agent is also an executor and a recovery approver: the recovery check comes before the agent and executor check.
An agent is also an executor, and the principal is a recovery approver: the agent and executor check comes first.
The principal is a recovery approver and the fee address a guardian: the principal check comes first.
The fee address is a guardian and the attester is the agent's key: the fee address check comes first.
The attester is the agent's key and there are five guardians: the attester key check comes before the set bounds.
Eleven approvers with approvals_required 0: the set bound comes before the approvals check, so the error is ROLE_SET_FULL.
No approvers with approvals_required 1, and no recovery approvers with a threshold of 1: the approvals check comes first.
Two approvers, approvals_required 3 and an agent who is also an approver: the role check at step 7 decides, so the error is ROLE_CONFLICT.
mallory, who is no agent, is named as the caller of a request that eve signs.
A guardian, who is no agent, requests on a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
A request on a mandate that is revoked and expired is MANDATE_REVOKED.
A request on a mandate that is expired and paused is MANDATE_EXPIRED.
A retry of a landed request on a paused mandate is MANDATE_PAUSED, not PAYOUT_ID_EXISTS.
A request at its deadline with a total of 0 is REQUEST_DEADLINE_PASSED.
A total of 0 with no legs is AMOUNT_INVALID: the amounts come before the leg count.
Five legs, one of them 0: the leg count is checked first.
A leg of 0 and a leg to the zero address: the leg amount is checked first.
A leg to the zero address and a leg with a non-canonical tag: the zero address is checked first.
A leg with a non-canonical tag and a leg to the fee address: the tag is checked first.
A leg to the fee address and two legs to bob: the fee address is checked before duplicates.
In ALLOWLIST mode, legs short of the total and an attestation: the sum is checked first.
In BOTH mode, a leg off the allowlist with no attestation: the attestation count comes first.
An attestation valid for one second too long with a 32-byte signature: the window is checked first.
A bad signature and a fee over a cap of 0: the signature is verified first, which traps on Stellar.
With the per-payment cap equal to the budget, 1001 breaks both: the cap is checked first.
After 500 of a 1000 budget is committed, 600 breaks the budget and a daily cap of 500: the budget is checked first.
600 against a daily cap of 500 and a free balance of 400: the daily cap is checked first.
mallory, who is no agent, is named as the caller of a request batch that eve signs.
A guardian, who is no agent, sends a request batch to a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
A request batch on a mandate that is revoked and expired is MANDATE_REVOKED.
A request batch on a mandate that is expired and paused is MANDATE_EXPIRED.
Eleven items, the first with a bad signature that would trap and the rest with no attestation: the length is checked before any item runs.
mallory, who is no approver, is named as the caller of an approval that eve signs.
A guardian, who is no approver, approves on a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
An approval on a mandate that is revoked and expired is MANDATE_REVOKED.
An approval on a mandate that is expired and paused is MANDATE_EXPIRED.
Approving an unknown payout on a paused mandate is MANDATE_PAUSED.
An unknown payout has no status to be PENDING: the lookup decides, so the error is PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND.
Approving a payout that is already APPROVED and has lapsed is PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS.
Approving a lapsed payout whose agent was removed is PAYOUT_LAPSED.
An approver approves again after the payout's agent was removed, with one of two approvals given: AGENT_REMOVED comes first.
mallory, who is neither an approver nor the principal, is named as the caller of a rejection that eve signs.
A guardian rejects on a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
The principal rejects an unknown payout on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
An unknown payout has no status to be PENDING: rejecting it is PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND.
A cancel naming the principal as caller but signed by mallory, on a revoked mandate: authorization comes first on Stellar.
The principal cancels an unknown payout on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
An unknown payout has no status to cancel from: the lookup decides, so the error is PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND.
mallory, who may not cancel, cancels a payout already cancelled: the status is checked first.
A cancel batch naming the principal as caller but signed by mallory, on a revoked mandate: authorization comes first on Stellar.
mallory, who may not execute, is named as the caller of an execute that eve signs.
A guardian executes on a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
An execute on a mandate that is revoked and expired is MANDATE_REVOKED.
An execute on a mandate that is expired and paused is MANDATE_EXPIRED.
Executing an unknown payout on a paused mandate is MANDATE_PAUSED.
An unknown payout has no status to be APPROVED: the lookup decides, so the error is PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND.
Executing a PENDING payout that has lapsed is PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS.
The principal executes a lapsed payout whose agent was removed: PAYOUT_LAPSED.
The principal executes a payout whose agent was removed and whose fee is over a lowered cap: AGENT_REMOVED.
A queued payout over a lowered per-payment cap, to a destination since removed: the cap is checked first.
After a policy change, a payout that would also pass the daily cap is POLICY_CHANGED.
After the first of two 600 payouts against a cap of 1000, and a clawback of 1, the second breaks the cap and the balance: DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED.
mallory, who may not execute, is named as the caller of an execute batch that eve signs.
A guardian sends an execute batch to a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
An execute batch on a mandate that is revoked and expired is MANDATE_REVOKED.
An execute batch on a mandate that is expired and paused is MANDATE_EXPIRED.
Eleven unknown IDs: the length is checked before any item is looked up.
mallory, who may not pause, is named as the caller of a pause that eve signs.
The agent, who may not pause, pauses a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
A guardian pauses a mandate that is both paused and revoked: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A guardian resumes a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal resumes a revoked mandate that is not paused: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A guardian revokes a mandate already revoked: only the principal may, which comes first.
A guardian withdraws an amount of 0: only the principal may, which comes first.
An amount above I128_MAX is also above the free balance: the domain is checked first.
A sweep naming mallory as caller but signed by eve, on an active mandate: authorization comes first on Stellar.
A third-party sweep of an active mandate with a principal change proposed: MANDATE_ACTIVE.
A third-party sweep at expiry with a principal change proposed: PRINCIPAL_CHANGE_PENDING comes before the grace.
A third-party sweep at expiry of an empty mandate: the grace is checked before the balance.
A guardian recovers the settlement asset: only the principal may, which comes first.
A guardian updates the limits of a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal sets a time to live of 0 on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
With no approvers, a time to live of 0 and a threshold equal to the cap: the field domains come first.
With no approvers and 1000 committed, a threshold equal to the cap and a budget of 999: the threshold is checked first.
Extending an expired mandate with 1000 committed, 999 held and a budget of 999: the budget is checked first.
A guardian adds an agent to a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal adds role code 9 to a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
Role code 9 for the zero address: the role code is checked first.
A fifth guardian whose key is the attester's: the attester key is checked before the set bound.
A guardian removes the agent of a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal removes role code 9 on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A guardian sets 5 on a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal sets 5 with no one to count on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A guardian sets 5 on a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal sets 5 with no one to count on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A guardian allows a recipient on a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal allows a recipient on a revoked ATTESTED mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
Eleven entries, one of them the fee address: the entry count is checked first.
An entry already present and an entry for the fee address: refused with CONFIG_INVALID either way.
A guardian disallows a recipient on a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal disallows a recipient on a revoked ATTESTED mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
An ATTESTED mandate keeps no allowlist: disallowing no entries is WRONG_RECIPIENT_MODE.
Eleven entries, one of them the fee address: the entry count is checked first.
An entry for the fee address and an entry not present: refused with CONFIG_INVALID either way.
A guardian sets the attestation policy of a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
The principal sets an attestation policy on a revoked ALLOWLIST mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
An ALLOWLIST mandate given the agent's key as attester: the mode is checked first.
A guardian proposes the zero address: only the principal may, which comes first.
mallory accepts a proposal whose address has since become an agent: only the proposed address may, which comes first.
A guardian cancels when there is no proposal: only the principal may, which comes first.
A guardian lowers the fee cap of a revoked mandate: only the principal may, which comes first.
mallory, who is no recovery approver, is named as the caller of a recovery revoke that eve signs.
A guardian votes to revoke a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
A recovery approver votes again after the principal revoked: MANDATE_REVOKED, not ALREADY_APPROVED.
mallory, who is no recovery approver, is named as the caller of a rotation that eve signs.
A guardian votes to rotate an agent of a revoked mandate: the role check comes first.
A recovery approver votes to rotate out a non-agent on a revoked mandate: MANDATE_REVOKED.
A rotation of a non-agent to an approver: the rotation target is checked before role separation.
A repeated vote for a new agent whose key has since become the attester's: the attester key is checked first.
A leg of 0 and a leg to the mandate itself: the leg amount is checked first.
